style: Anime-forward 2.5D: bold drawn contours, expressive stylized faces, angular cel-shadow planes, textured fabric and environments, dimensional depth; less naturalistic facial rendering and no photorealism.

a-boca-de-vidro.name: A Boca de Vidro (A Serpe)
review: All six scenes show her continuous coiling lower body as translucent spiritual glass; no human legs or hips.
The passive shows essence falling away from the exposed enemy without transferring it to A Serpe.
Single-target attacks show one enemy; Discurso em Estilhaços shows exactly three enemies.
Reflexo da Boca is personal defense and shows only A Serpe.

o-falso-profeta.name: O Falso Profeta
review: Six stable anime-first base sprites were reviewed against the identity portrait and current kit targets.
Confissão do Falso Santo has a distinct self-healing and cleansing image; the base technique path remains independent.
The personal defense shows only the user; no combat rules, target, costs, duration or cooldown changed.
Twelve base sprites and one alternative-form sprite were prepared for integration.
A Serpe's revised canonical anatomy and target counts were checked in the final 512x512 crops.
O Falso Profeta remains on the custom active route used by src/character-identity.js.
pendingScope: Seventeen of 100 base character sets now follow the anime-first line (102 of 600 base sprites). Eighty-three base sets remain; alternative forms, A Máscara Dupla's body-form art, and other game visuals also remain in scope.
